project: TTT-Hybrid Lab independent native four-block research; no FORGE authority

hypotheses.H1: Original random ttt.proj may distort the 16D bounded raw-memory content.
hypotheses.H2: Mixing projected raw memory by addition with unrelated frozen native context into 16D before original depth/head may make valid memory information inaccessible to a simple trainable linear head.
hypotheses.H3: A separate content/context channel could preserve information, but must disclose extra 16D readout features and learned parameters, without claiming equal full-model memory or compute.

source.generator: Novel independent author-synthetic per-world random orthogonal 16D target action keys paired with independently sampled 16D tanh effects, each repeated twice plus 8 singleton normalized distractor action/observed-effect pairs, 24 events uniformly shuffled; final simulated executed target action query=action16 plus zero16 unknown effect. No role/time/query/future effect given as historical factual observation.
source.source_audit: FIT and VAL max quartile target-position imbalance <=0.05 and heldout position-only balanced accuracy <=0.55; source SHA256 of factual input/query/labels/role audit; no P65-P79 consumed data reuse; no sealed OOD generated; future query effect must be all zero.
source.negative: Independent author-synthetic negative source, shuffle effect credit within each history, final true effect/query fixed, no tuning on negative source.

models.frozen_original: Original exact HybridPilot(input_dim=32, output_dim=16,width=16,heads=2,ssm+attn+TTT+depth), frozen random 3 model seeds [810201,810203,810207], no optimizer updates to any original core weights or original model.py.
models.factual_state: P78 BoundedRawTTT original-size 16x16 (256 float32) raw executed action/effect fast state, eta 0.5, read-before-write, exact cold restore; original SSM and attention causal history separately included in full-core compute; no auxiliary raw memory.
models.fit_only_linear_probe: Closed-form L2 ridge on FIT labels with alpha=0.01, 16 output effects, float64 solve, bias unregularized, fixed hyperparameters; no validation/OOD optimizer updates.

features.raw_16: Direct bounded raw-fast W@normalized(query_action); fixed direct conventional 256-float baseline
features.native_context_16: Exact original stem->SSM->attention final query latent, no factual fast contribution
features.memory_projected_16: Exact original frozen ttt.proj(raw_16), without context and without depth; isolates projection.
features.memory_projected_after_depth_16: Exact frozen depth( original frozen ttt.proj(raw_16) ) without native residual; isolates depth.
features.sum_pre_depth_16: Original native final latent + original frozen ttt.proj(raw_16), before depth; original compressed additive fusion.
features.sum_post_depth_16: Original depth(native last + original frozen ttt.proj(raw_16)), as input to original head; exact P79 raw_internal 16D pre-head representation.
features.concat_32: Concatenation of native context and raw_16, 32D FIT-only ridge; 2x readout features and additional 16*16 parameters vs 16D, no equal-budget claim.
features.native_memory_actual: Original native four-block reference output with full factual history, diagnostic baseline only.

models.control: Same FIT and VAL worlds, original core weights and original 256-float factual state for all feature arms. Report matrix ranks/condition numbers of learnable directions, zero-state and model initial errors. No adaptive feature selection.

preregistered_decisions.source: Any malformed factual source, leakage, unexpected model SHA or cold restore fail stops; do not generate OOD.
preregistered_decisions.raw_sufficient: Original fixed raw_16 direct VAL MSE <=0.75*zero-state VAL MSE for all models; FIT-only ridge on raw_16 <=0.90*fixed direct VAL MSE in all three seeds; otherwise original premise unqualified.
preregistered_decisions.oracle_readout: FIT-only ridge on concat_32 <=1.10*ridge(raw_16) VAL MSE for each seed; a linear head with separate raw memory must be competent.
preregistered_decisions.projection_test: FIT-only ridge(memory_projected_16) <=1.15*ridge(raw_16) => projected memory remains linearly decodable; otherwise classify projection bottleneck under this specific frozen random core.
preregistered_decisions.depth_test: FIT-only ridge(memory_projected_after_depth_16) <=1.15*ridge(raw_16) => depth preserves readout accessibility; otherwise classify depth bottleneck under this specific frozen random core.
preregistered_decisions.fusion_test: If FIT-only ridge(sum_post_depth_16) >=1.25*ridge(raw_16) in each seed while concat_32 <=1.10*ridge(raw_16), classify frozen additive-fusion bottleneck supported in 3/3; if threshold only subset, report mixed/failed not PASS.
preregistered_decisions.negative: Independent negative source wrong-credit direct fast MSE >=2x clean source MSE and >=0.1; source seeds distinct; FIT ridge coefficients fixed before negative scoring.
preregistered_decisions.success_label: DEV_MECHANISTIC_DIAGNOSTIC_PASS_ONLY if source/cold/raw/oracle/negative all pass and either at least one of projection/depth/fusion failure patterns consistently appears in all seeds. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE/FAIL. This never proves causal architectural learning gains or SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
preregistered_decisions.stop: No OOD data generation/scoring. No post-result threshold/source re-selection. Preserve nulls and all data/weights hashes.
preregistered_decisions.limitations: Frozen randomly initialized original core and 256-float raw fast-state trained on an authored source family, not complete trained original model, not real unfamiliar transfer, no authentic physical first-use, no matched fully-trained alternate models, no whole-process compute equality.
